names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 27 aprilie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Simeon, ruda Domnului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Συμεών ο Αδελφόθεος Επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων», with the rank word, the epithet and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 27. април ст. ст., „Св. апостол Симеон.“ Св. is not a rank, and апостол is the `apostle` this folder already carries in `types` and `honorific.js` composes back. The heading gives no epithet and no kinship clause — the son of Cleopas and the kinsman of the Lord, which this corpus's English name keeps, are the body's — so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form. One other folder holds it; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

The name index at page 1997 is titled «Святой Симеон, апостол от 70-ти», whose words beside the forename are a rank and a company and are stripped per BRIEF.md §4; the day’s line gives «Симеона , сродника Господня», which is a kinship and not an epithet of place or office. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO SURNAME AND NO TOPONYM, so the stored form is the bare forename, as BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2 leaves it where the calendar gives no more. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'симеон' is an EXISTING key of four holders — `simeon-of-persia`, `simeon-the-fool-for-christ`, this folder and `symeon-with-theonas-and-pherbinus` — and THIS FOLDER IS ALREADY ONE OF THE FOUR, through the Serbian «Симеон» it has carried since the Serbian wave. So the form adds a second route to a membership that does not change, the key is already marked read in the gate, and it was NOT touched, per the standing instruction not to rewrite a key this branch did not write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 апреля ст. ст. — «Ап. и сщмч. Симеона , сродника Господня (107).»

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. The line heads him «(107)», which is the year the folder already holds off saint.gr, so `dates` was NOT touched. The name index behind the line is page 1997, «Святой Симеон, апостол от 70-ти», and it lists TWO readings, both of which were read. THE TWO DISAGREE ABOUT HIS AGE AND NEITHER WAS WRITTEN AS A FACT: life6845 has him crucified «в возрасте 120 лет», a hundred and twenty, which is saint.gr’s figure and the one the folder’s own `dates` note already records; life939 has him taken when he was already «столетним старцем», a man of a hundred. The folder’s interval stands unchanged on the first reading and the second is set out in the life. What the two add between them: he was the son of Клеопа, the younger brother of Joseph the Betrothed; he governed the Church of Jerusalem FORTY YEARS (life6845) and was chosen to it by the Christians after the killing of the apostle James, whom this calendar dates «(+ 63; память 23 октября)»; he came to believe in maturity, having seen the Lord’s wonders, and was numbered among the Seventy; and the denunciation to the Roman governor Аттик under Trajan (98–117) was that he was of the line of king David — «римляне уничтожали всех потомков царя Давида» — as well as a Christian. Both pages head «Дни памяти: 4 января (70 ап.) , 27 апреля»; 4 января is the synaxis of the Seventy and NOT a second feast of this folder, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. The day page prints three hymns under his name, a troparion (глас 1), «Ин тропарь» (глас 4) and a kontakion (глас 4), and all three are on this folder now beside its three Greek texts. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 27 aprilie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Simeon, ruda Domnului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Συμεών ο Αδελφόθεος Επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same man: successor of James the Brother of the Lord in Jerusalem, crucified under Trajan. **The Greek adds four things.** It heads him «(-12 - 107)» and says he was crucified «το έτος 107 μ.Χ., σε ηλικία εκατόν είκοσι ετών», in 107 at the age of a hundred and twenty; only the 107 is recorded in `dates`, because the head's negative year is the page's arithmetic from that age and not a stated year of birth. It sets out the two accounts of his kindred side by side — «Κατά τον Ηγήσιππο ήταν υιός του Κλωπά, αδελφού του Ιωσήφ, και αδελφός του Ιούδα· κατ άλλη δε εκδοχή ήταν υιός του Ιωσήφ του Μνήστορος και αδελφός του Αγίου Ιακώβου του Αδελφοθέου» — by Hegesippus a son of Clopas the brother of Joseph and brother of Judas, by another account a son of Joseph the Betrothed and brother of James. It dates the succession to the destruction of Jerusalem by the Romans in 70 and James's death to 62, dates Trajan 98 to 117, and names the consul Atticus to whom he was denounced, insisting that the accusers were Jews and not Christian heretics and that the charge had two heads, his descent from David and his being a Christian. And **it records a second day and disowns it**: «Ορισμένοι Συναξαριστές περιττώς επαναλαμβάνουν τη μνήμη του και στις 18 Σεπτεμβρίου» — some synaxaristes needlessly repeat his memory on 18 September; 27 April is the day both the listing and the page head give and is what this row records, and the 18 September is noted here in the source's own dismissive words and is not a second row. It adds that a service for him by the hymnographer Theophanes is in the Paris codices. It prints one apolytikion and two kontakia, all three naming Symeon and so all three proper to him, which are stored here; its megalynarion is neither of the two kinds this corpus holds and was left.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.05.2026 (27. април ст. ст.) — „Св. апостол Симеон.“

attestations.note: The same man: one of the Seventy, son of Cleopas and so nephew of Joseph the Betrothed, second bishop of Jerusalem after James, crucified over the age of a hundred under Trajan on the double charge of David's descent and of Christ. **It gives no year**, so the 107 this folder carries from saint.gr stands untouched and no birth was added. Its account of the reckoning is the Romanian life's first reading and not the second — Cleopas the brother of Joseph, Symeon his son — stated flatly and argued nowhere. New from this book: that the Jews killed James **by pushing him from the height of the temple and striking him on the head with a club**, where doxologia has him thrown down from the seat of the Church and struck with wood; that Symeon preached „свуда по Јудеји“, everywhere through Judea; that he governed „са мудрошћу и силом“ into deep old age; and that the persecution under Trajan was raised in Palestine against the house of David and against the Christians as two persecutions at once, „двојако гоњење“. It names no proconsul, where both other calendars name Atticus. The Prologue prints no hymn.

death.note: saint.gr: «Αφού συνελήφθη, βασανίσθηκε σκληρά και στη συνέχεια οδηγήθηκε σε σταυρικό θάνατο, το έτος 107 μ.Χ., σε ηλικία εκατόν είκοσι ετών» — crucified in the year 107 at the age of a hundred and twenty. The page heads him «(-12 - 107)»; that first figure is the page's own subtraction from the age of a hundred and twenty and not a year it states anywhere in its text, so no year of birth is recorded here.

hymns.text: Χριστοῦ σε συγγενῆ, Συμεὼν Ἱεράρχα, καὶ Μάρτυρα στεῤῥόν, ἱερῶς εὐφημοῦμεν, τὴν πλάνην ὀλέσαντα, καὶ τὴν πίστιν τηρήσαντα· ὅθεν σήμερον, τήν παναγίαν σου μνήμην, ἑορτάζοντες, ἁμαρτημάτων τὴν λύσιν, εὐχαῖς σου λαμβάνομεν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Χορὸς Ἀγγελικός, on the page of «Άγιος Συμεών ο Αδελφόθεος Επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων»

english.text: Thee, the kinsman of Christ, O hierarch Symeon, and a steadfast martyr, we praise in holy fashion, who didst destroy error and keep the faith; wherefore, as we keep thy all-holy memory today, we receive by thy prayers the loosing of our sins.

hymns.text: Τῆς ἄνω Σιών, πολίτης γενόμενος, τῆς κάτω Σιών, τὸν θρόνον ἐγκεχείρισαι· καὶ καλῶς τό ποίμνιον, ὁδηγήσας πρὸς μάνδραν οὐράνιον, ἐσταυρώθης Χριστῷ Συμεών, τό θεῖον πάθος αὐτοῦ μιμησάμενος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν, on the page of «Άγιος Συμεών ο Αδελφόθεος Επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων»

english.text: Having become a citizen of the Sion above, thou wast entrusted with the throne of the Sion below; and having guided the flock well towards the heavenly fold, thou wast crucified for Christ, O Symeon, imitating His divine passion.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἀστέρα μέγιστον ἡ Ἐκκλησία, κεκτημένη σήμερον, τὸν θεηγόρον Συμεών, φωταγωγεῖται κραυγάζουσα· χαίροις Μαρτύρων σεπτὸν ἀκροθίνιον.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιος Συμεών ο Αδελφόθεος Επίσκοπος Ιεροσολύμων»

english.text: The Church, possessing today as her greatest star the God-speaking Symeon, is led into the light and cries out: rejoice, O honoured first-fruits of the martyrs.

hymns.text: Христова тя сродника, Симеоне священноначальниче,/ и мученика тверда священно восхваляем,/ прелесть потребившаго/ и веру соблюдшаго./ Темже, днесь всесвятую твою память празднующе,// грехов разрешение молитвами твоими приемлем.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь апостола Симеона», глас 1, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 27 апреля ст. ст. The day’s own line grades him «Ап. и сщмч.» and all three texts under his name address the kinsman of the Lord and bishop of Jerusalem by name, so all three are his own propers.

english.text: In sacred song we praise thee, O Symeon, chief of the priesthood, as the kinsman of Christ and a steadfast martyr, who didst bring delusion to nothing and didst keep the faith. Therefore, keeping thy all-holy memory today, we receive by thy prayers the loosing of our sins.

hymns.text: В мире радуешися, Симеоне Иерусалимский,/ любезно Христу Богу,/ тело душевное чисто сохранив,/ претерпевши страсть телесную, долготерпеливе, крепко,/ и в конец на кресте распят бысть./ Ты бо, Истинному Рачителю подобяся,/ и от мира скоро отлучися,/ лютыя язвы на себе понесе/ и молишися о душах наших.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Ин тропарь апостола и священномученика Симеона, епископа Иерусалимского, сродника Господня», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 27 апреля ст. ст. The day’s own line grades him «Ап. и сщмч.» and all three texts under his name address the kinsman of the Lord and bishop of Jerusalem by name, so all three are his own propers.

english.text: Thou rejoicest in peace, O Symeon of Jerusalem, dear to Christ God, having kept the body of thy soul pure and having endured the suffering of the body bravely, O long-suffering one, and at the last wast crucified upon a cross. For being made like unto Him who truly loved thee, thou wast quickly parted from the world, didst bear cruel wounds upon thee, and prayest for our souls.

hymns.text: Яко звезду превелию,/ Церковь, имущи днесь богоглаголиваго Симеона,/ световодится, зовущи:/ радуйся, мучеников// честный венче.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак апостола Симеона», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 27 апреля ст. ст. The day’s own line grades him «Ап. и сщмч.» and all three texts under his name address the kinsman of the Lord and bishop of Jerusalem by name, so all three are his own propers.

english.text: Having today in Symeon, who spoke the words of God, a very great star, the Church is led by his light and cries out: Rejoice, honoured crown of the martyrs.
